purpose: Support the rolling estimator with bounded-storage retained evidence over an approximately ten-year horizon; replace candidate thrashing by explicit error obligations and a proof dependency graph.

user_decisions.C_meaning: User confirmed RC-branch capacitances C_i=tau_i/R_i, distinct from Q
user_decisions.aging_trends: R increases, Q and RC-branch C decrease as intended aging directions; not yet certified monotone laws for fitted effective quantities
user_decisions.envelope_status: Approximate design assumptions, not empirical calibration, hard truncation or probability coverage

inherited_targets: plans/estimation_targets_001.json: capacity5percent hard/preferred0.5percent relative point error; SOC10pp hard/preferred0.5pp. Not estimator certificates; unresolved/weak-stimulus periods remain explicit.

state_contract.equivalence: Replace tau_i by R_i*C_i; do not estimate R,C,tau as three independent quantities for one mode.
state_contract.positive_reference_requirement: Relative R/C aging needs positive reference branch parameters with carried uncertainty, not truth-derived point anchors. Existing support touching R=0 cannot silently become a certified positive lower bound.
state_contract.baseline_uncertainty: Relative envelopes are around declared reference quantities; their uncertainty and relationship to current health must be retained or bounded.
state_contract.existing_model_gap: Current minimal health model evolves Q,R0 only. RC aging, its state-continuity convention and transition uncertainty are not yet implemented or calibrated.
state_contract.no_silent_physics_change: Do not infer v-continuity versus C*v charge continuity from tau=R*C alone. An aging state-transfer convention is a separate physical assumption. Preserve actual charge, intervals and chronology.

proof_objects.exact_model_filter: pi_k = normalize(L_k * (pi_(k-1) K_k)); augmented state includes all variables needed to make the admitted model Markov
proof_objects.token: Prior-free incremental evidence plus chronological transition/context, unique source ownership and model/noise version; a rolling posterior is not automatically such a token
proof_objects.gallery: Finite dictionary of conditional stimulus/response operators or likelihood basis functions, with accumulated coefficients and an aging-aware boundary belief; not a histogram of posterior point estimates
proof_objects.core_error: Distance between decoded compressed belief and exact admitted-model belief; physical model discrepancy and finite-reference error are separate
proof_objects.strong_audit_distance: D(p,q)=essential oscillation of log(dp/dq), finite only under common support and bounded likelihood ratio
proof_objects.query_distance: Physical SOC/Q/response and uncertainty functionals, with declared domain and closure/stability obligations; marginal moment matches alone are insufficient

ten_year_theorem_obligations: Specify useful query-error budgets separately from point targets and confidence/coverage
Specify admitted stimuli, weak-excitation status and maximum informative-gap or drift uncertainty
Specify a calibrated aging kernel or defensible set-valued transition; envelopes alone are insufficient
Prove token ownership and exact/proved-approximate chronological operator composition
Prove a finite gallery/message closure or a uniform approximation defect bound over reachable states
Prove lifetime error budget under no contraction, or actual block contraction in the chosen metric; do not invent a forgetting factor
Prove arithmetic range/error and maximum event/update rate for the ten-year horizon;35Hz is nominal only
Account for complete SRAM and work, not just retained numeric payload
nonclaims: Recent8/32record comparisons prove error grows with calendar time
Bounded parameter values imply useful tracking accuracy or filter contraction
A finite gallery of similar inputs is an exact sufficient statistic for aging histories
Independent repeated noise observations can be deleted without preserving their information weight
Written conditional lemmas or finite controls qualify the nonlinear battery estimator for ten years
Conventional probability/operator lemmas prove SCM,NAIA,D2 or D2E
